# Statistical Significance, Impact, and Relevance

On this page you will find documents on the subject of endogeneity. This presentation is part of the PhD course Statistical Significance, Impact, and Relevance. The presentation is build in Quarto, an open-source publishing system that enables the creation of dynamic, reproducible presentations by seamlessly integrating markdown, code, and outputs. Unlike PowerPoint, Quarto allows for automated content updates and version control through code, while offering greater flexibility and customization compared to Beamer’s LaTeX-based approach. This makes Quarto especially ideal for data-driven presentations that require collaboration and maintainability.


- [**You can find the interactive `reveal.js` presentation here**](https://janteichertkluge.github.io/research/Stat_Sig/endogeneity.html#/)
- [**Or you can download a rendered version as PDF](https://janteichertkluge.github.io/research/Stat_Sig\Endogeneity_v04.pdf)
